label: holds the debt of
notes: This is the channel into the caravan. Pell owes a Bell Harrow broker and has to keep coming back to her town, so Thecla never needed to plant anyone on Ysoly's train - she already owns a man on it. He pays her in news because news is cheaper than salt, and he does not experience that as betrayal, which is what makes the chapter 3 leak tragedy instead of villainy. He wants it cleared before his daughter is old enough to inherit it.
